{{Quote|This is where they have their base! They aren't a very friendly bunch, so be careful!|[[Boyrake]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Lok}}</ref>}}
The '''Canyon Corsair's Stronghold''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. It was the base of operations of the [[Canyon Corsairs]],<ref name="SWG:CCS" /> a band of [[Pirate/Legends|space pirates]] who plagued the [[Karthakk system]].<ref name="SCKS">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66849&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Karthakk System}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I have information regarding the 'Kimogila Town,' and 'Canyon Corsair Stronghold.' They are all interesting places, I assure you.|[[Talia v'laenya]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Tv">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Talia v'laenya|Lok}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Naval]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Boyrake]] and the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Talia v'laenya]] discovered the location of the Canyon Corsair's Stronghold on Lok.<ref name="SWG:AC" /><ref name="SWG:Tv" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] shipped contraband to [[Marla]] at the Canyon Corsair's Stronghold.<ref name="SWG:SC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Smuggle Contraband|Lok}}</ref> Around the same time, a spacer infiltrated the stronghold and stole a grooved [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWG:RPWMI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Pistol Weapons Mark I}}</ref>

The same year, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bronell]] dispatched a spacer to the pirate stronghold in order to retrieve information about a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer who owned money to Jabba, as well as to the pirates.<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Bronell"</ref>
